description: Computed daily snapshot of the CWI public data surface. Every number below is derived from a live source at generation time; sources and the regeneration method are documented in this file. Numbers are never estimated.
regeneration_method: Recompute daily: 1) tracks = count non-empty lines of datasets/tracks.jsonl. 2) skus = count items[] in gear.json (must equal lines of datasets/agent-deck-skus.jsonl). 3) verified_placements = length of verified_placements[] in datasets/placements.jsonl (the NEEDLE DROP sync ledger). 4) verified_playlist_placements = length of verified_placements[] in catalog.json (Spotify playlist holds). 5) verified_playlist_holds = total tracks across catalog.json holds. 6) dataset_rows = sum of non-empty lines across the 5 .jsonl dataset files. 7) curator_statuses = tally the 'status' field of datasets/curators.jsonl. 8) endpoints_live = count of the canonical endpoints that return HTTP 200 on fetch at generation time; record the checked list and the ones that failed, if any. No field may be carried over from a prior day without re-fetching its source.

sources.dataset_rows: 5 .jsonl dataset files: agent-deck-skus 25 + curators 4 + placements 1 + press 10 + tracks 24 = 64
